title: Gudun aiki, bayyanannun amsoshi da kwantar da hankulan abokan ciniki
course_title: Tallafin Abokin Ciniki na Kan layi

say: Gudun aiki, bayyanannun amsoshi da kwantar da hankulan abokan ciniki.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module 2 na Tallafin Abokin Ciniki na Kan layi.
Wakilai masu kyau ba sa amsa saƙonni kawai ba. Suna motsa kowace buƙata ta matakai iri ɗaya kowane lokaci, don haka babu abin da aka rasa.

panel.kicker: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi

say: Yawancin aikin tallafi shine rubutu. Rubutun share fage yana adana lokaci, saboda abokin ciniki ya fahimci lokacin farko.

say: Wasu kalmomi suna tura abokan ciniki. Laifi, a'a, da kuma lokuta marasa ma'ana kamar da wuri-wuri.

say: Sauya zargi da bayani. Ba za a iya maye gurbin da abin da za ku iya yi ba. Kuma maye gurbin kalmomi marasa ma'ana da lokutan gaske.

say: Amsar daftarin farko ta ce: eh za mu iya yi, farashin ya dogara, aika cikakkun bayanai. Wannan bai gaya wa abokin ciniki komai ba.

card.title: Bayyanar magana, ba farashi ya dogara ba

say: Sake rubutawa yana ba da farashin farawa: daga kusan naira 3,500 akan kowane kan.

card.title: Bayyanar magana, ba farashi ya dogara ba

say: Ga baƙi 80, wato kusan naira 280,000, kafin a kai da kuma hidimar ma'aikata.
Sannan ya jera ainihin bayanan da ake buƙata kuma yayi alƙawarin zance a cikin sa'o'i 2. Abokin ciniki zai iya yanke shawara lokaci guda.

card.title: Bayyanar magana, ba farashi ya dogara ba

say: Abokin ciniki na Mariam, Tola, ya rubuta da manyan haruffa: Na biya 12,500 a makon da ya gabata kuma ba komai. Mariam ta saurara kuma ta sake cewa: Ina ganin kun biya 12,500 kuma kun aika sako sau uku.

say: Kada ku zargi mahayin ko abokin ciniki har sai kun bincika. Kuma kada ku rubuta kwantar da hankali, ko kamar yadda na fada a baya.

panel.rule: Ka nemi afuwar abin da ta same ta. Tabbatar da kuskure kafin suna.

say: Wasu lokuta ba naku bane don magance su kaɗai. Barazana na cutarwa, matakin shari'a ko yaƙin neman zaɓe na jama'a, da matsalolin amincin samfur, kamar cutar da fata ko rashin lafiyar abinci, tafi kai tsaye zuwa ga mai kula da ku ko mai shi. Don haka a sake dawo da kuɗaɗen da ake zargin zamba. Log kowane daya.

panel.heading: Ƙarfafa zuwa ga mai shi lokaci guda
items: Barazanar cutarwa
Matakin doka ko yakin neman zabe
Rashin lafiyar fata ko rashin lafiyar abinci
Maidawa da kuma zargin zamba

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da matakai shida kowane lokaci, kuma ku yi duk tambayoyinku a cikin saƙo mai lamba ɗaya. Rubuta a sassa biyar, tare da ainihin lokuta. A kwantar da hankula tare da LAST.
Kuma idan abokin ciniki ya yi kuka a cikin jama'a, ba da amsa sau ɗaya, a taƙaice kuma cikin ladabi, sannan matsa zuwa tattaunawa ta sirri.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Yarda, bayyana, dubawa, warwarewa, tabbatarwa, shiga
Duk tambayoyi a cikin saƙo mai lamba ɗaya
Gaisuwa, yarda, amsa, mataki na gaba, kusa
KARSHE: Saurara, Neman gafara, Warware, Na gode
korafin jama'a: amsa sau ɗaya, matsa zuwa na sirri

say: Juyin ku. Gudun shari'ar gaskiya ko ta gaskiya ta duk matakai shida. Rubuta aƙalla samfura 6 kuma sake rubuta raƙuman martani guda 3. Sai ka rubuta amsa ta ƙarshe ga saƙon fushi, kuma ka tambayi abokinka yadda yake jin karantawa.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Guda harka ɗaya ta duk matakai shida
Rubuta aƙalla samfuri 6
Sake rubuta amsoshi 3 masu rauni
Rubuta amsa ta ƙarshe ga saƙon fushi
